title: SuccessSparkline component
definitionOfDone: SuccessSparkline renders colored bars for each run outcome
Pure CSS/SVG implementation, no chart library

implementationPlan.description:
Create `SuccessSparkline` in `dashboard/src/components/workflows/SuccessSparkline.tsx`.

Pure CSS flex implementation. Props: `data: RunStatus[]`, `className?: string`.

If `data.length === 0`, return `null`.

Render: `<div className={cn('flex items-end gap-px', className)}>` containing `data.map((status, i) => <div key={i} className="w-0.5 h-4" style={{ backgroundColor: colorMap[status] ?? '#6b7280' }} />)`.

Color map: `succeeded: '#22c55e'`, `failed: '#ef4444'`, `cancelled: '#6b7280'`, `running: '#3b82f6'`, `timed_out: '#ef4444'`, default gray.

Memoize with `React.memo` since data changes infrequently. No chart library needed.

SECURITY: No user input in rendering — status values are typed enum strings. Only inline `backgroundColor` style (no CSS injection vector since values are from hardcoded map).

Verify `node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit`.
implementationPlan.note: Created memoized SuccessSparkline: pure CSS flex bars, 2px wide, 16px tall, succeeded bars 100% height, others 75%. Colors from hardcoded map. Returns null for empty data. tsc clean.
